description:
RCB, in association with the Rotary District 3141 team, successfully organized a *Mega Medical Camp on 27th August, 2026, at Punjabi Gali Diagnostic Centre, Borivali West.*

The camp offered free-of-cost health check-ups including CBC, Blood Sugar, Blood Pressure, Total Cholesterol, TSH Thyroid, and Vitamin D & B12 tests.
The camp also included Dental Check-ups and Hearing Assessment, an initiative by President for mega medical camp.

More than *75 beneficiaries* including house maids, drivers, security staff, vegetable vendors, cobblers and other members of the community availed the benefits of this camp.

*RCB Members who attended:*
President Rtn. Aarti Parekh, PP Rtn. Manish Gyani, Rtn. Dr. Dharmaji Shinde, Rtn. Deepak Gupta, Rtn. Dr. Kanak Ganguly, Rtn. Vandana Dodhia, Rtn. Amrish Trivedi, Hon. Member Ms. Deepa Patil and 3 Rotaractors.

*Our heartfelt thanks to:*

1. Rtn. Dharti Joshi, Avenue Director - Medical, for her tireless efforts in coordinating the project.

2. Our ever-willing Knight in a white coat, Rtn. Dr. Dharmaji Shinde, for taking complete charge of the dental camp and conducting it so ably. He responded with alacrity to our requests and was a bedrock of support throughout.

3. President suggested Medical directorbto distribute leaflets to the vegetable vendors and Cobblers. Medical director arranged translation of the camp leaflets from English to Hindi and Marathi for the benefit of local vendors, and distributed over 100 leaflets to potential beneficiaries. He also arranged water and buttermilk for all attendees.

4. Rtns. Amrish Trivedi and Ms. Deepa Patil for mobilizing the beneficiaries.

5. Ms. Bina Doshi for coordinating approvals and arrangements at the venue. We also thank R/Ann Sonal Chandarana for sharing Ms. Doshi's contact details.

6. Rtn. Deepak Gupta for arranging tea, coffee and snacks for everyone at the camp.

7. Team Dhwani Aurica, Borivali, for efficiently managing the hearing camp.

The combined efforts of all involved made the Mega Medical Camp a resounding success.

Photos enclosed.
